meta.title: A rejected proposal returns the event to awardable
gaps: The exact field indicating `should_allow_awarding` is not exposed in the read_event schema, so verification is limited to successful creation of a new proposal.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the award proposal call, the request the case itself writes.
The buyer opens an award proposal.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals active.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals active.
